evals.prompt: A webhook handler returns 200 after putting the event into an in-memory queue. Add retries because our downstream sometimes times out.
evals.expected_output: Challenges the durability/acknowledgement boundary before adding retries; proposes persist-before-ack if survival is required, idempotency for duplicate delivery, end-to-end deadlines/cancellation, bounded jittered retries, and terminal failure handling.

evals.prompt: The worker, HTTP client, and queue consumer each retry three times. During an outage load exploded. How should we redesign this?
evals.expected_output: Identifies multiplicative retries and retry-storm risk; assigns a bounded retry policy/budget, classifies retryable errors, applies jitter/deadlines and downstream protection, and tests outage/exhaustion behavior.
